title: Google Search with FlashData
description: Use an existing FlashData API key and Credits. Begin with a price check; then explicitly choose a search and its quoted Credits limit.

flashdataApiKey.title: FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Your FlashData key with Google Search permission. Stored as an encrypted Actor input. Search calls use this account’s FlashData Credits.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Check price makes free FlashData account reads. Run search performs one paid Google Search request after checking maxCredits. Apify platform usage is separate.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Keywords or a Google search expression. A single query is sent per run.

maxCredits.title: Maximum quoted FlashData Credits
maxCredits.description: Set above zero to run a search. The Actor stops before submitting if the current quote exceeds this value. This is a preflight check, not a server-enforced account spending limit.

num.title: Requested results
num.description: Requested result count; actual count can be lower. Does not automatically fetch additional pages.

page.title: Search page
page.description: Fetch this page only. Each additional page requires a separate paid request.

gl.title: Country code
gl.description: Optional two-letter country code, such as us or gb.

hl.title: Interface language
hl.description: Optional language code, such as en or de.

tbs.title: Google search filter (tbs)
tbs.description: Optional Google filter expression, such as qdr:w for the past week.
